proseStories.heading: ED Corner – July 2026
proseStories.originalText: Happy July, everyone! It's been an amazing summer so far of cookouts, nights spent with friends, and of course, refreshing Happy Hours to help us cool down. ... Have a great month! Yours in Service, Olivia Hermiller, Executive Director

proseStories.heading: Legacy News — Dementia Action Week balloon release
proseStories.originalText: We honored Dementia Action Week with a special balloon release in memory of those we have lost to dementia and in support of everyone affected by it. Our residents enjoyed the sunshine on such a beautiful day.

photoCaptionBlocks.caption: Sunshine, smiles, and plenty of fun! We're so grateful for these special moments that bring joy, connection, and a little extra sparkle to our residents' days!

Our residents had a wonderful time celebrating Senior Day with a fun-filled outing! We always enjoy creating moments like these for our residents to relax, connect, and have a fantastic time out in the community!
